_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Putting the session on a board…

description: Put the session on a MIRO or MURAL board with Metodic's own board export: an agenda frame, a frame per activity with its steps, and the wall canvases, ready for an online or hybrid workshop. Returns the board link at once; the activities are drawn on it over the next minute or two. Costs 2 Metodic credits. If the user has not connected Miro or Mural to Metodic yet, it returns the link to connect it instead (and charges nothing).
name: export_board
title: Put it on a board
